A checklist holds criteria, each evaluation records one finding per criterion, and the findings of a ticket are summarised in its result [1][3][4].

```mermaid
erDiagram
    DorChecklist ||--o{ DorCriterion : "holds"
    DorCriterion ||--o{ CriterionFinding : "judged as"
    DorEvaluation ||--o{ CriterionFinding : "records"
    Verdict ||--o{ CriterionFinding : "classifies"
    CriterionFinding }o--o{ TicketResult : "summarised in"
    TicketBrief ||--|| TicketResult : "yields"
    TicketStatus ||--o{ TicketResult : "labels"
```

The checklist is loaded from `dor.yaml`, never from Jira [2].
